---
title: "Architecture decision records"
toc: false
---

Architecture decision records (ADRs) are the durable decision log for the HRL
data infrastructure. Narrative architecture pages explain the current design;
ADRs preserve the reason each significant decision was made, the options
considered, and the consequences of the choice.

::: {.callout-note}
The ADR inventory includes both accepted and proposed decisions. Accepted ADRs
represent current design direction. Proposed ADRs are still under review and
should not be treated as final policy.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const adrNumber = (row) => {
    const text = row.children[0].textContent.trim();
    return Number.parseInt(text.replace(/\D/g, ""), 10);
  };

  const adrCompare = (a, b) => adrNumber(a) - adrNumber(b);
  const topicCompare = (topicIndex) => (a, b) => {
    const topicA = a.children[topicIndex].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    const topicB = b.children[topicIndex].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    return topicA.localeCompare(topicB) || adrCompare(a, b);
  };

  const textCompare = (columnIndex) => (a, b) => {
    const valueA = a.children[columnIndex].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    const valueB = b.children[columnIndex].textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
    return valueA.localeCompare(valueB) || adrCompare(a, b);
  };

  const addSortControl = (header, label, compare, tbody, sortControls) => {
    const originalLabel = header.textContent.trim();
    header.textContent = "";

    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "table-sort-control";
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", `Sort ADRs by ${label}`);
    button.setAttribute("aria-sort", "none");

    const labelSpan = document.createElement("span");
    labelSpan.textContent = originalLabel;

    const arrowSpan = document.createElement("span");
    arrowSpan.className = "table-sort-arrow";
    arrowSpan.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    arrowSpan.textContent = "↕";

    button.appendChild(labelSpan);
    button.appendChild(arrowSpan);
    header.appendChild(button);
    sortControls.push({ button, arrowSpan });

    let ascending = true;
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));
      rows.sort((a, b) => {
        const result = compare(a, b);
        return ascending ? result : result * -1;
      });

      rows.forEach((row) => tbody.appendChild(row));
      sortControls.forEach((control) => {
        if (control.button !== button) {
          control.button.setAttribute("aria-sort", "none");
          control.arrowSpan.textContent = "↕";
        }
      });
      button.setAttribute("aria-sort", ascending ? "ascending" : "descending");
      arrowSpan.textContent = ascending ? "↑" : "↓";
      ascending = !ascending;
    });
  };

  const addSortableHeaders = (table, columns) => {
    if (!table) return;

    const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");
    if (!tbody) return;

    const sortControls = [];
    columns.forEach(({ columnIndex, label, compare }) => {
      const header = table.querySelector(`thead th:nth-child(${columnIndex + 1})`);
      if (header) {
        addSortControl(header, label, compare, tbody, sortControls);
      }
    });
  };

  const currentTable = document.querySelector(".adr-inventory table");
  if (currentTable) {
    const tbody = currentTable.querySelector("tbody");
    Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr")).forEach((row) => {
      const statusCell = row.children[2];
      const status = statusCell.textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (status === "accepted" || status === "proposed") {
        statusCell.innerHTML = `<span class="adr-status adr-status-${status}">${statusCell.textContent.trim()}</span>`;
      }
    });
    addSortableHeaders(currentTable, [
      { columnIndex: 0, label: "ADR number", compare: adrCompare },
      { columnIndex: 2, label: "status", compare: textCompare(2) },
      { columnIndex: 3, label: "date", compare: textCompare(3) },
      { columnIndex: 4, label: "topic", compare: topicCompare(4) }
    ]);
  }

  addSortableHeaders(document.querySelector(".forthcoming-decisions table"), [
    { columnIndex: 0, label: "ADR number", compare: adrCompare },
    { columnIndex: 3, label: "topic", compare: topicCompare(3) }
  ]);
});
</script>
```
